Rebuild and contribute

The website source, assets, tests and automation are preserved on GitHub. These instructions and scripts are also available here:

  • Project README and local setup
  • Contributing evidence and corrections

Imported credits remain distinct from newly checked relationships. Missing records are research gaps, not evidence that an affiliation or contribution does not exist. Named institutions and archives are not implied sponsors.

Third-party artwork and portrait rights remain with their respective rights holders. Source and image credits are retained in the collection; public access is not a blanket reuse license.
